summary: Verified TipJar Rate Wall status system: per-leg WON (green) & LIVE (blue) badges on Häcken parlay, 4-status filter buttons (Pending/Live/Won/Lost) in order, silent auto-refresh (no flicker over 22s), and clean mobile layout. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: RateWall.jsx is 319 lines — still within limits but the STATUS_META map + TipCard could be split into a component file for maintainability if it grows.
STATUS constant on line 16-18 is defined but unused (filter uses an inline array on line 124) — safe to remove dead code.
In `load()` catch block, errors are silently swallowed ('/* ignore */') — for silent polling this is intentional, but consider logging to a debug flag in dev.
test_credentials: Not required (public view). Admin: admin@tipjar.com / TipJarAdmin2026! (not tested)
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed_showcase() Häcken parlay + Portugal & Messi tip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RateWall status colors + silent polling verified. Häcken parlay leg statuses are: 'won' (Häcken–Djurgården, green) & 'live' (Portugal–Spanien, blue). Tip-level status is 'pending'. Filters (won/live/lost) return empty state — expected per agent-to-agent note. Silent auto-refresh runs every 20s without triggering Loading spinner or clearing tips list.
verified_features: leg-status-won badge renders GREEN with 'WON' text and green match title (bg-won/15 text-won)
leg-status-live badge renders BLUE with 'LIVE' text and blue match title (bg-live/15 text-live) with pulsing icon
status filter buttons: status-pending, status-live, status-won, status-lost — present in order with correct labels
Filter clicks work: pending shows 2 cards; won/live/lost show wall-empty (expected)
status-badge-pending count = 2 (both showcase tips show amber PENDING at tip-level)
Silent polling: 22s wait, no 'Loading...' text ever appeared with tips already loaded; card count stayed at 2 (no flicker)
No console errors caught during polling
Mobile (390x844) layout intact: both cards render, WON/LIVE badges & colors correct
